title: Black and white boat bands; packet boats and stevedores
summary: Most excursion bands were white, some boats had black bands, and black stevedores unloaded the freight packet boats.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable
